description: Save current in-memory changes as a new DWG; never overwrites. Reopens and verifies all object bytes and section payloads first. Hosted HTTP storage: saves a new account-owned stored drawing (optional name) and returns fileId plus a downloadUrl to present as a link; rootUri and path are not used. Local stdio: requires rootUri and a new relative .dwg path inside the root, and returns that path.

name.description: Hosted only: file name for the new stored drawing, e.g. plan-v2.dwg.

path.description: Local stdio only: new relative .dwg path inside the root; parent directory must exist.

name: cad.save_as
